title: Erdős--Falconer distance conjecture from an analytic perspective
summary: Let \(q\) be an odd prime power and let \(V=\F_q^{2m}\), equipped with \(Q(x)=x_1^2+\cdots+x_{2m}^2\). We develop a semidefinite Delsarte framework for the two-set Erdős--Falconer distance problem over \(V\). The framework reduces the natural \(q^m\)-scale positive-proportion theorem to a uniform \(L^1\) anti-concentration statement for positive convex combinations of classical Kloosterman sums.
